what_it_does: Builds four per-base masks for a chromosome: it compares every 6-base window to TTAGGG and to CCCTAA, counts mismatches, and spreads hits over their 6 bases. exact = bases under a perfect motif of either strand; degen = bases under a motif with 1..MAX_MISMATCH mismatches that are not already exact; fwd = bases under any TTAGGG hit; rev = bases under any CCCTAA hit.
inputs: chromosome sequence
rule_or_threshold: mismatches per 6-mer: 0 = exact, 1..MAX_MISMATCH (default 1) = degenerate

what_it_does: Calls telomere blocks per chromosome. A 300-bp scan window (step 150) is positive when at least 40 percent of its bases are covered by exact or degenerate motif hits; overlapping positive windows are merged; each merged region is trimmed to its first and last covered base and kept if at least 60 bp. For each block it reports copy numbers (bases/6), percent identity (exact bases over exact+degenerate), strand from the TTAGGG vs CCCTAA base counts, which chromosome end is nearer, terminal vs internal, the number of positive windows, overlapping period-6 TRF ids and a QC flag. Per chromosome it counts left/right terminal/internal blocks and calls T2T when both ends have a terminal block.
inputs: as __script__
rule_or_threshold: window 300 bp step 150; density >= 0.40; merge when window start <= previous end; block >= 60 bp (>= 10 copies); strand + if fwd bases > 1.5*rev bases, - if rev > 1.5*fwd, else ambiguous/mixed; which_end left if distance to left <= distance to right; terminal if min distance to an end <= --tel-dist 200000; qc PASS if percent_identity >= --min-perfect (default 0) else WARN_degenerate; TRF support = period 6 rows overlapping (first 20 ids); T2T if a terminal block exists at both ends

what_it_does: Command-line entry for finding unannotated insertions inside satellite arrays (read-only on the pipeline). At import it loads 53b_topology_compare.py as module T to reuse its annotation loader. main() reads the step-02 arrays and step-03 copies, loads all annotation features via T.load_annotations, reads the needed chromosomes with read_fasta, and per array finds uncovered stretches between satellite copies, splitting them into annotated elements and insertion candidates.
inputs: --out pipeline folder (02_satellite_arrays.tsv, 03_monomer_copies.tsv); --genome FASTA; --func; --overlays (passed to T.load_annotations: EDTA, AnnoSINE, GMATA, barrnap, tRNAscan, miRNA, Rfam, LiftOn CDS/exon, detgaps); --genome-tag G; --dest; --min-bp 50; --min-units 0.5; --junk-id 65; --conf-id 80
rule_or_threshold: see main

what_it_does: Reads only the chromosomes named in need from a FASTA file into a dict (sequence not upper-cased here; main upper-cases slices).
inputs: FASTA path; set of chromosome names

what_it_does: Per step-02 array: confident copies are complete copies with identity at or above --conf-id; at least two are needed. The array extent is from the first confident copy start to the last confident copy end. Annotation features overlapping that extent (GAP excluded) are loaded; a feature label is called intrinsic to the satellite (and ignored) when it overlaps more than 30 percent of the confident copies (overlap at least half the shorter of copy and feature). Satellite tiles are copies with identity at or above --junk-id; the gaps between successive tiles are candidate spans. A span is kept when it is at least max(--min-bp, --min-units x period) long and has at most 5 percent N. If annotation features cover at least half of it, it is written as an annotated element with the top label; otherwise it is an insertion with GC, relative position in the array, array family, period, left/right neighbouring copy family and class (nearest copies with identity at or above --junk-id), the number of low-identity (junk) copies inside it and the annotated bp.
inputs: as __script__
outputs: 54_ins_<G>.tsv columns ins_id subgenome array_id chrom start0 end length GC rel_position array_family period_02 left_family left_class right_family right_class n_junk_tiles annotated_bp; 54_ins_<G>.fa; 54_annotated_elements_<G>.tsv
rule_or_threshold: confident copy: complete and identity >= 80; >= 2 confident copies; intrinsic label: hits > 0.30 x confident copies with overlap >= 0.5 x shorter length; satellite tile: identity >= 65; span length >= max(50, 0.5 x period); N <= 5 percent; annotated element if feature coverage >= 50 percent of span; rel_position = (span start - extent start)/(extent length)

what_it_does: Script with top-level code, no main(): argv = MODE (cluster or annotate), D (folder with 54_ins_*.tsv/.fa and BLAST outputs), OUT (pipeline out root). It always loads the Gar and Mac insertion tables and FASTAs (fasta). MODE cluster: single-linkage (union-find) families from allvsall.tsv, members table and representative FASTA. MODE annotate: best_hits per library, genome copy counts inside/outside step-02 arrays, period_of per representative, status, family table.
inputs: D/54_ins_Gar.tsv, D/54_ins_Mac.tsv, D/54_ins_Gar.fa, D/54_ins_Mac.fa; cluster: D/allvsall.tsv (BLAST outfmt 6 + qlen slen); annotate: D/54b_ins_members.tsv, D/54b_family_reps.fa, D/reps_vs_TElib.tsv, D/reps_vs_SINElib.tsv, D/reps_vs_satlib.tsv, D/reps_vs_genome_Gar.tsv, D/reps_vs_genome_Mac.tsv, OUT/fClaHyb_<G>_satellites/02_satellite_arrays.tsv
outputs: cluster: D/54b_ins_members.tsv (family, ins_id, is_rep, degree), D/54b_family_reps.fa (recurrent families only); annotate: D/54b_ins_families.tsv
rule_or_threshold: edge: identity >= 80 and alignment length >= 0.5 x shorter sequence, self-hits skipped; representative = most edges, ties longest; recurrent = >= 3 members in >= 2 arrays; known library hit: identity >= 80 over >= 50 percent of the representative; genome copy: identity >= 80 and alignment >= 50 percent of representative, inside if overlapping any step-02 array of that subgenome; status order known_TE > known_SINE > satellite_family > novel_dispersed (>= 10 copies outside arrays, both subgenomes summed) > novel_array_restricted; family ids INSF0001... by size

what_it_does: Reads a FASTA file into a dict of name (first header word) to sequence.
inputs: FASTA path

what_it_does: Reads one BLAST table of representatives against a library and keeps, per representative, the single best library hit that passes the known thresholds, ranking hits by identity x coverage. Returns an empty dict when the file is missing.
inputs: BLAST outfmt-6 path with qlen slen as last two columns
rule_or_threshold: identity >= 80; coverage = alignment length / query length >= 0.5; best = max identity x coverage

what_it_does: Estimates an internal tandem period of a representative: records every position of each 8-mer, takes the distances between successive occurrences of the same 8-mer, and returns the most common distance and the fraction of positions it accounts for.
inputs: sequence; k=8
rule_or_threshold: period = modal recurrence distance; fraction = its count / (len - 7)

what_it_does: Script with top-level code: argv W = the step-54 folder. Reads 54b_ins_families.tsv, parses the 5S-rDNA and relaxed satellite BLAST tables with hits(), assigns each recurrent insertion family a class by the first matching rule, writes the classified table and prints counts plus the novel families with at least 10 members.
inputs: W/54b_ins_families.tsv; W/reps_vs_5S.tsv; W/reps_vs_satlib_relaxed.tsv
outputs: W/54c_ins_families_classified.tsv (54b columns + class, relaxed_sat_hit, hit_5S); stdout summary
rule_or_threshold: rule order: known_TE (TElib_hit) > known_SINE > 5S_rRNA (5S hit identity >= 80 over >= 50 percent of shorter) > satellite_family (satlib_hit from 54b, >= 80) > diverged_satellite_own_host / diverged_satellite_other (relaxed satlib hit identity >= 60 over >= 30 percent; own_host if the hit family is one of the members host families) > nested_tandem (internal_period_frac >= 0.25 and period <= median length / 3) > novel_dispersed (Gar+Mac outside-array copies >= 10) > novel_array_restricted

what_it_does: Parses a BLAST table and keeps hits passing an identity and a coverage cut-off (coverage relative to the shorter of query and subject); the subject name is the last pipe-separated field. Returns per query a list of (subject, identity, alignment length / query length).
inputs: BLAST path; pid cut-off; cov cut-off
outputs: dict query -> list of (subject, identity, qcov)
rule_or_threshold: identity >= pid; alignment length >= cov x min(qlen, slen)

what_it_does: Command-line entry that rescues tandem stretches step 36 left without a run. It imports 50_local_library_decomposition.py as module M50 (registered in sys.modules so pool workers can unpickle M50.tile_work). main() loads the step-36 run BED, selects 1-kb bedgraph windows with tandem signal but little step-36 coverage (cover), merges them into targets, re-cuts each target with M50.tile_work (local library), builds rescued runs with a unit-dependent minimum run length, labels every run (step 36 + rescued) with its genomic context from the LiftOn GFF3 and writes tables plus an IGV BED.
inputs: --out (36_characterized_intervals.bed); --tag; --genome; --signal <T>_tandem_signal_1kb.bedgraph; --genes LiftOn GFF3 (.gz ok); --igv folder; --min-signal 0.05; --merge 1000; --min-bp 1500; --threads 2; --slack 0.15; --iterations 2
rule_or_threshold: see main

what_it_does: Counts how many bp of the interval [s, e) on chromosome c are covered by the union of a set of intervals.
inputs: dict chrom -> list of (start, end); chrom; s; e

what_it_does: Target windows are bedgraph windows with signal at or above --min-signal whose bp are less than half covered by step-36 runs; windows within --merge bp are joined and targets shorter than --min-bp dropped. Targets are tiled in 20-kb tiles and decomposed by M50.tile_work. In each tandem tile copies are promoted by local identity with the unit-size cut-off, and runs of promoted copies are formed with a minimum run length that shrinks for long units; each rescued run is named tile|rescue_run#|unit|copies|id and its copies written. Each run (36 and rescued) is labelled CDS, genic_noncoding or intergenic with gene names from the GFF3, and counts/Mb per source and context are summarised.
inputs: as __script__
outputs: 51_rescued_runs.bed; 51_rescued_copies.tsv (tile_id chrom start0 end length_bp strand local_identity promoted run local_unit_bp); 51_all_runs_context.tsv; 51_summary.tsv; IGV BED
rule_or_threshold: window kept if signal >= 0.05 and step-36 coverage < 50 percent; merge gap <= 1000 bp; target >= 1500 bp; tiles 20000 bp; promotion identity >= 0.85 if unit <= 60 bp else >= 0.75; min run = max(4, min(10, ceil(3000/unit))) promoted copies with <= 1 non-promoted inside; context CDS if >= 50 percent of run bp in CDS, genic_noncoding if any gene overlaps, else intergenic; gene name from gene_name/Name/gene attribute, list truncated to 60 chars

what_it_does: Command-line entry for local-library monomer decomposition of centromere targets. At import it loads 03d_period_constrained.py (M3D: consensus_from, dp_decompose, rc), 39_cross_subgenome_families.py (X39: K2P.register, compare, read_fa) and 48_run_sequence_validation.py (V48: profile, seq_period) from the fixed path PIPE and IndexedFASTA from v4_array_utils. main() builds targets from 31_centromere_summary.tsv (+/- --pad) and an optional --extra BED, splits them into tiles, runs tile_work in a Pool initialised by _init, assigns each tile consensus to a registry family, promotes copies, builds runs and writes tiles/copies/runs/summary (coverage before from 36_characterized_intervals.bed).
inputs: --out; --tag; --genome; --tile 20000; --pad 0; --slack 0.15; --iterations 2; --id-sat 0.75; --id-mini 0.85; --min-run 10; --threads 3; --extra BED; files in --out: 31_centromere_summary.tsv, 37_family_registry.tsv, 04_satellite_family_consensuses.fa, 36_characterized_intervals.bed; PIPE = /mnt/f/data/satellite_FISH/pipeline_v4_5_fixed/scripts (hard-coded)
rule_or_threshold: see tile_work and main

what_it_does: Imports a Python file from an explicit path as a module under a given name.
inputs: module name; file path

what_it_does: Rejects low-complexity windows such as (TG)n or poly-A: a window passes when it is at least 20 bp, its commonest dinucleotide makes up under 35 percent of dinucleotides and its trinucleotide entropy is at least 3.5 bits.
inputs: sequence window
rule_or_threshold: len >= 20; top dinucleotide fraction < 0.35; 3-mer entropy >= 3.5 bits

what_it_does: Picks a seed copy of length p inside a tile and the fixed-phase frames around it. Candidate windows every p/4 bp are scored by base identity to the next p bp; the best-scoring candidate that passes complexity_ok is the seed (fallback: best overall). Frames are the p-long windows, in phase with the seed, within 30 periods on each side; frames failing complexity_ok are dropped unless that leaves none.
inputs: tile sequence; period p; local=30
rule_or_threshold: candidate step max(1, p/4); frames within +/- 30 x p of the seed

what_it_does: Pool worker initialiser: opens an IndexedFASTA on the genome and stores the argument namespace (slack, iterations) for tile_work.
inputs: genome path; args

what_it_does: Processes one tile: fetches its sequence; returns gap if over 20 percent N. Measures the dominant k-mer recurrence period with the step-48 statistic (V48.profile, V48.seq_period); returns not_tandem when no period, no finite excess, excess under 0.02 or period under 10 bp. Otherwise builds a local consensus: seed and frames from seed_frames_complex, at most 200 frames evenly sampled, each rotated/oriented onto the seed (X39.K2P.register), majority consensus (M3D.consensus_from) computed twice; then --iterations rounds of period-constrained DP tiling of the tile against the local consensus (M3D.dp_decompose, copy lengths within +/- slack of p) and re-building the consensus from copies with identity at least 0.6 that pass complexity_ok (stops early if fewer than 8).
inputs: job tuple (tile id, chrom, start, end); genome via _W
outputs: tuple (tile id, chrom, start, end, period, state gap/not_tandem/tandem, pieces [(abs start, abs end, strand, identity)], local consensus)
rule_or_threshold: gap if N > 20 percent; profile window min(3000, len/3), seq_period threshold 0.85; tandem iff period >= 10 and excess >= 0.02; frames sampled to 200; copy length bounds [max(8, round(p(1-0.15))), round(p(1+0.15))]; refinement copies identity >= 0.6 and complexity_ok, need >= 8, sample 200, reference = middle copy; 2 iterations

what_it_does: Builds targets (one per row of 31_centromere_summary.tsv named <tag>_<chrom>_CEN, extended by --pad, plus --extra BED rows), cuts them into --tile bp tiles (tiles under 2 kb dropped), runs tile_work in parallel, then for each tile assigns the local consensus to the registry family with the best circular strand-aware identity (nested assign: families whose length differs by more than 40 percent are skipped unless one is about twice the other), promotes copies by local identity, builds runs of promoted copies, and writes copies, tiles, runs (BED name target|tile-run|family|copies) and a per-target summary comparing bp covered by step-36 runs with bp covered by the new runs.
inputs: as __script__
outputs: 50_local_tiles.tsv (tile_id chrom start0 end state local_period_bp n_copies mean_local_identity promoted_in_runs best_family family_identity local_consensus); 50_local_copies.tsv; 50_local_runs.bed; 50_target_summary.tsv (covered_bp_36, covered_bp_50, frac_36, frac_50, median_local_identity, tile_families)
rule_or_threshold: tile >= 2000 bp; promotion identity >= 0.85 if period <= 60 else >= 0.75; run >= 10 promoted copies with <= 1 non-promoted copy inside; family length filter: |len diff| <= 40 percent of longer, or ratio/2 in (0.4, 0.6)
